Selected Work 02

Nº 01 — Formation

Creating Experian's First Design System

No formal design system existed — multiple domain teams independently created UI patterns with only a style guide for loose guidance. Led the creation of the first reusable component libraries across iOS, Android, and Web. The effort formalized into Experian's first official design systems team, and leadership mandated all new projects use the system.
Design Systems Token Architecture Governance 3 Platforms
Nº 02 — Adoption

Proving the System Works

Building a design system is one thing — proving it actually helps is another. Multiple UI systems coexisted in production with no visibility. Conceived and prototyped an adoption tracking platform that turned 'is the design system working?' from an opinion into a dashboard.
Adoption Strategy Design Tooling 4 UI Systems Tracked
Nº 03 — Unification

Atlas Component Merge

Platform-specific Figma libraries for web, iOS, and Android had evolved independently. Co-led the merge effort, releasing in waves over two months with a formal deprecation process and hands-on migration support.
Change Management Cross-platform 5 Libraries → 1
Nº 04 — Zero to One

Building SpeakUp from Zero

Co-founded a workplace collaboration platform. Owned all design — branding, product UI, marketing site — while leading a remote team of six engineers. The platform reached break-even and remains live today.
Co-founder Product Design 6-Person Team
Nº 05 — Team Building

Paciolan Design System

Inherited a product with no shared design language and a team of six designers working independently. Built the company's first design system while establishing a formal UX review process.
Design Systems Team Management 6 Designers
